stories.title: Zverev dashes American hopes, beats Shelton in US Open final for 2nd major
stories.summary: Alexander Zverev won his second major championship and kept American men without a Grand Slam title since 2003, beating Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 on Sunday in the US Open final.

stories.title: Murray's Vikings debut ends early as QB suffers concussion
stories.summary: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion after taking a hard hit in his Minnesota debut.

stories.title: Giants WR Nabers active for opener vs. Cowboys
stories.summary: New York Giants standout wide receiver Malik Nabers is making his return from a torn ACL in Sunday night's season opener versus the Cowboys.

stories.title: Monken noncommittal on Watson, calls it 'unfair' to blame loss on QB
stories.summary: Todd Monken sidestepped a question about whether he will stick with Deshaun Watson as the Browns' starter, but he said it was unfair to blame Sunday's 34-10 loss on the veteran QB.

stories.title: Titans fall flat in coach Saleh's debut as Ward struggles
stories.summary: The Titans suffered a 23-10 loss to Robert Saleh's former team, the Jets, while quarterback Cam Ward had a tough outing, completing 19 of 32 attempts for 140 yards and one touchdown.
